description: Split one local PDF into a ZIP of PDFs. Costs 1 credit on success. Default is one PDF per page; use at_pages for split points or ranges_json for explicit inclusive ranges.

at_pages.description: Comma-separated split points after 1-based page numbers, e.g. "3,7"

path.description: Absolute path to a PDF file

ranges_json.description: JSON array of inclusive [start,end] page ranges, e.g. "[[1,3],[4,7]]"

name: exactpdf_split_pdf
